title: Invert Binary Tree
statement: Invert a binary tree given in level order and return the inverted tree in level order, omitting trailing nulls.
hints: Swap the two children of every node.
Recursion does the swap after, or before, inverting the subtrees. The order of the swap and the recursive calls does not matter.
An empty tree inverts to an empty tree.

approaches.name: BFS swap
approaches.explanation: A queue visits every node and swaps its children.

approaches.name: DFS swap
approaches.explanation: The call stack is the height.

editorial: Inversion is a homomorphism: invert(node) swaps left and right and inverts both sides. The base case is a null child. Level-order serialization is only the input and output format. The algorithm itself walks nodes.

examples.explanation: Every left and right child swaps.
